acts: AIFC Rules No. FR0008 of 2017 (AML Rules)

en.title: AML Guidance refers to Chapter 6 for risk assessments; they are in Chapters 4 and 5
en.summary: Guidance (k) after AML 4.3.3 and Guidance (j) after AML 6.3.4 refer to the customer risk assessment "under Chapter 6", and the sanctions Guidance (g) to "the risk assessments under Chapters 5 and 6". AML 1.5(d) places the customer risk assessment in Chapter 5; Chapter 6 contains none.
en.correction: Please align the risk-assessment references in the Guidance with the business and customer risk assessment provisions (Chapters 4 and 5).
